comments: Configuration template for Rerunner Plugin - Skeleton Joint Coordinates Time Series

_documentation.time: Column/field name in your data that contains timestamps
_documentation.skeleton_type: Type of skeleton model (e.g., 'hpe_18' for 18-joint human pose)
_documentation.skeleton_keypoint_paths: Paths to each joint's position data in the input JSON
_documentation.enable_bones: Show skeletal connections between joints in 3D view
_documentation.enable_keypoints: Show individual joint positions in 3D view
_documentation.enable_timeseries: Automatically enable real-time time series visualization (default: true)
_documentation.use_confidence_colors: Color code joints by confidence (red=low, green=high)
_documentation.min_confidence: Minimum confidence threshold for displaying skeleton data
_documentation.enable_rate_limiting: Enable rate limiting to prevent gRPC overload (default: true, REQUIRED for stability)
_documentation.frame_delay_microseconds: Delay between frames in microseconds (default: 5000 = 5ms, increase if errors persist)
_documentation.keypaths: Additional sensor data to plot (optional - for non-skeleton signals)

_output_organization.skeleton: 3D skeleton visualization with bones and keypoints
_output_organization.timeseries/skeleton: Time series plots of each joint's X, Y, Z coordinates

_visualization_output: Left panel: 3D skeleton with bones connecting joints and color-coded keypoints
Right panel: Time series graphs showing how each joint's X, Y, Z coordinates evolve
Hover over time series to see exact values
Click joint names to highlight/unhighlight in the plot
